text: Si woni yogo e rewɓe mon njaltii faade e heefereeɓe ɗaɓɓudon teŋe mum en e heeferɓe he ɓe tottaani on keɓdon e heeferɓe ganngal, totte worɓe ɓe koɓe tottrno ko, ɓeen ɓe rewɓe mum en njaltuno na murti, yeru koɓe tottirno ko e teŋe, kule Alla mbo goonɗin ɗo O, ciinon jamirooje makko ndeentoɗon ko O reentini ko.
